title: Boolean counter increment
statement: For a natural number $r$, a counter $c\in\{0,\ldots,r+1\}$, and a Boolean $b$, define the updated counter to be $\min(c+1,r+1)$ when $b$ is true, and $c$ when $b$ is false.
